## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: broad sector participation (Healthcare, Tech, Financials showing 1W gains) but a MAJOR divergence across mega-caps where many large names show 1W up / 1M down; Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology). Sector snapshots: Healthcare 14/17 positive, Technology 15/24 positive, Financials 13/20 positive, Consumer Stpl. 10/14 positive, Consumer Disc. 9/14 positive, Communication 6/10 positive, Materials 6/11 positive, Industrials 7/15 positive, Real Estate 3/10 positive, Energy 2/10 positive, Utilities 2/10 positive.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Healthcare leads: JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +13.20%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +14.07%) ABOVE TREND. Technology showing headline leaders: PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +13.60% | 1M: -16.17%) RECOVERY. Financials strength in cards: MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +14.12%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Utilities weak: VST (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -4.25%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -12.25%) BELOW TREND. Energy under pressure: XOM (1W: -0.33% | 1M: -8.34%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -9.78%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate mixed/soft overall.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: PLTR (1W: +20.54% | 1M: -15.03%) RECOVERY, NOW (1W: +18.77% | 1M: -16.71%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +13.60% | 1M: -16.17%) RECOVERY, APD (1W: +12.94% | 1M: +13.19%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology), style: Growth/Momentum tilt but concentrated.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: T (1W: -8.21% | 1M: -16.48%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -8.84% | 1M: +5.90%) CORRECTION, INTC (1W: -9.42% | 1M: +11.51%) CORRECTION, AMAT (1W: -9.72% | 1M: +23.06%) CORRECTION, DLR (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -6.84%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Communication, select Tech names and Utilities.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W movers: PLTR (1W: +20.54% | 1M: -15.03%) RECOVERY, NOW (1W: +18.77% | 1M: -16.71%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +13.60% | 1M: -16.17%) RECOVERY, AAPL (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) RECOVERY. Note MAJOR divergence among large caps (many 1W vs 1M conflicts) — tactical moves, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed with RECOVERY pockets and BELOW TREND anchors. NVDA (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -12.46%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: +10.67% | 1M: -11.52%) RECOVERY, GOOGL (1W: +4.71% | 1M: -0.48%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +7.37% | 1M: -2.37%) RECOVERY — Sector breadth: 15/24 positive; watch earnings/news flow for confirmation.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Constructive and relatively broad. MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +14.12%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +11.13%) CORRECTION — Sector breadth: 13/20 positive; style: Value/Cyclical elements present but Growth tilt remains in leadership.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Defensive leadership intact. JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +13.20%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +14.07%) ABOVE TREND — Sector breadth: 14/17 positive; supports risk-averse allocations within a neutral regime.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor rotation within the market: emphasize Financials and Healthcare leaders while monitoring Technology momentum names for confirmation. Reduce exposure to Utilities and Energy pockets showing BELOW TREND and be selective in Tech given concentrated leadership and MAJOR divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: QCOM (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -12.55% | 1M: +5.16%) CORRECTION — watch for follow-through on recent catalysts.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Healthcare (14/17 positive) and Financials (13/20 positive) on momentum and earnings-related flows. BEARISH: Utilities (2/10 positive) and Energy (2/10 positive) where weakness is concentrated.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
PANW near short-term breakout to validate ABOVE TREND continuation; NVDA support zone to hold for Tech stability (NVDA (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -12.46%) BELOW TREND). MA and V strength should confirm Financials leadership if 1W follow-through continues.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
AMAT (+50): AMAT (1W: -9.72% | 1M: +23.06%) CORRECTION — bullish analyst action but weekly selling = trend exhaustion/divergence. QCOM (+50): QCOM (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%) BELOW TREND — news-tone bullish but price declining, clear distribution. APD (news flagged bearish but stock strong): APD (1W: +12.94% | 1M: +13.19%) ABOVE TREND — monitor for catalyst vs valuation debate.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
LRCX (-45): LRCX (1W: -12.55% | 1M: +5.16%) CORRECTION — guidance/AI demand fears align with near-term weakness. APD (-50 headline): APD (1W: +12.94% | 1M: +13.19%) ABOVE TREND — negative valuation call contrasts with price strength, watch for news-driven re-rating. QCOM (- listed bullish earlier) shows sentiment/price splits worth watching.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Growth/Momentum tilt given concentrated Tech leaders and solid Healthcare/Financial breadth. MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR divergence across mega-caps (many 1W up / 1M down) and several news-price contradictions (e.g., QCOM, AMAT) — monitor for trend confirmation.
